title: Out-of-range year crashes the server process (Int32 conversion traps)
evidence: Sources/BookService/BookStore.swift:125 — sqlite3_bind_int(statement, index, Int32(value)); a POST/PUT with year > 2147483647 (decoded as Int) traps at runtime and kills the whole service
suggestion: Use sqlite3_bind_int64 with Int64(value), or validate year range in BookInput.validated() and return 400

title: Tests cover BookStore only; HTTP routing and status codes are untested
evidence: Tests/BookServiceTests/BookStoreTests.swift:4-36 — all 4 tests call BookStore directly; HTTPServer.swift:48-95 (routing, 201/204/400/404 mapping, ?author= parsing) has no test
suggestion: Add an integration test that starts HTTPServer on an ephemeral port and exercises each route

title: Unsupported methods on known routes return 404 instead of 405
evidence: Sources/BookService/HTTPServer.swift:80-83 — default: break falls through to 404 "Not found" (e.g. PATCH /books/1)
suggestion: Return 405 Method Not Allowed for known paths with unsupported methods
